headline: On last trading day, Nifty reclaimed 25,000 and Sensex surpassed 81,000 led by banking and pharmaceutical gains.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Strong performance in banking and pharmaceutical sectors drove the market higher
A correction in global oil prices supported the positive momentum in Indian equities
The market recovered from a dip seen during the previous Muhurat trading session
Gains in PSU Bank stocks contributed to the indices finishing in the green
whatHappening: NSE and BSE are closed today, November 10, for the Diwali Balipratipada holiday
L&T secured a contract worth ₹1,000 - ₹2,500 crore for the Noida Metro extension
Nifty 50 settled above 25,000 while Sensex ended over 100 points higher on Monday
BDR Pharma is set to acquire a stake in Acme’s oral solid formulations business
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Diwali Balipratipada after Nifty reclaimed 25,000 in the last session. Banking and pharmaceutical stocks led the gains, while L&T secured a major metro rail order. The market recovered from its Muhurat trading dip to end in the green.
